values.quote: At the molecular level, there is no distinction between the random component and the ordered component.

values.value: pressure produced by the random component
values.quote: We measure the pressure produced by the random component as the static pressure.
The pressure produced by the ordered motion is called dynamic pressure.

values.value: pressure produced by the ordered motion
values.quote: The pressure produced by the ordered motion is called dynamic pressure.
And Bernoulli’s equation tells us that the sum of the static and dynamic pressure is the total pressure which we can also measure.

values.value: sum of the static and dynamic pressure
